visual.text: A frightening, witch-like old hag with an enormous, very long hooked nose that reaches down past her chin, a jutting pointed chin, sunken cheeks and glaring, malicious deep-set eyes. A sly, menacing grin shows crooked teeth. Long, thin, wild, unkempt hair falls down past her shoulders. She is gaunt and wiry but fully fleshed; her arms and hands are thin and wrinkled, with knobbly knuckles and long fingers ending in sharp nails. She wears ragged peasant clothes and leans on a gnarled wooden staff. Full figure.

visual.text: A three-headed dragon standing on four powerful clawed legs, with two large wings spread from its back and a long, thick dragon tail. Each of its three heads rises on its own long neck, ferocious, with open jaws and sharp teeth; one head breathes a stream of fire. Scaled body. Full figure.
visual.note: Ben: the common image is a three-headed, four-legged, winged dragon, not the sourced winged serpent.

visual.text: A monochrome silverpoint character study: a single figure alone on plain off-white paper, drawn only in fine grey metalpoint lines and hatching, like a page from a Renaissance master's sketchbook. An uncanny old spirit of the forest in the shape of a gaunt, wild old man, dressed in moss, bark, dead leaves and forest debris. One of his arms is gnarled and knotted like a tree branch, half arm and half wood. From his head grow branching antlers of gnarled tree branches, many-pointed like a stag's antlers but made of wood and twigs. He has a long, tangled beard, a long drooping moustache and dishevelled hair hanging down. His eyes are wild, staring and cold, and his expression is unfriendly and menacing: a wandering creature of the woods that might eat a lost traveller. His legs are reverse-jointed, bending backward at the knee like the hind legs of a beast, and end in gnarled, clawed feet. Full-length figure: the whole body from head to feet inside the frame, isolated on blank paper.
visual.note: Ben, round 4: plates drifted to colour and photorealism with backgrounds; the style is restated at the head and every setting removed. Seed 31 was right apart from the style.

visual.text: A monochrome silverpoint character study: a single figure alone on plain off-white paper, drawn only in fine grey metalpoint lines and hatching, like a page from a Renaissance master's sketchbook. The gruesome corpse of a young village woman, half rotted, with a dead, horrible expression. Her lower jaw is entirely missing: her face ends at her upper teeth, and below them hangs only a very long, grotesque, creepy tongue, dangling down over her throat and chest and tapering to a point. Grey, rotting skin and flesh cling to her skull and body, torn open in places to show bone; her arms are thin and withered but still fleshed. Her eyes are solid white, rotted and blind, in deep black sockets. She wears a rotted, tattered peasant festival dress and a wreath of withered field flowers on her matted hair, and holds a curved sickle. Full-length figure: the whole body from head to feet inside the frame, isolated on blank paper.
visual.note: Ben, round 4: plates drifted to colour and photorealism with backgrounds; the style is restated at the head and every setting removed. No lower jaw at all; solid white rotted eyes; never happy. Seed 32's tongue and rot were good.

visual.text: A monochrome silverpoint character study: a single figure alone on plain off-white paper, drawn only in fine grey metalpoint lines and hatching, like a page from a Renaissance master's sketchbook. A gaunt, malnourished, hairless monster, humanoid but monstrous. Thin skin is stretched tight over a starved, fleshed body: its belly is sucked in hollow beneath the rib cage, and its limbs are skinny and sinewy. Its legs are digitigrade and reverse-jointed, like a dog's hind legs: it stands on its toes, and the knee bends backward. Its forearms are very long and end in long, sharp claws. Its face is narrow and pointed, with long pointed ears and a vicious mouth full of sharp teeth, and a row of bony knobs runs down its spine. Crouching. Full-length figure: the whole body from head to feet inside the frame, isolated on blank paper.

visual.text: A monochrome silverpoint character study: a single figure alone on plain off-white paper, drawn only in fine grey metalpoint lines and hatching, like a page from a Renaissance master's sketchbook. A thin, gaunt young woman, a malevolent spirit of the lake, dripping as if she has just risen from a swamp. Her very long, wet, straggling dark hair falls in heavy strands over her shoulders and down her chest, and her breasts are covered only by her hair, which is tangled and entwined with leaves, weeds and swamp vegetation. Wet water plants and leaves trail loosely around her hips, leaving her thighs and legs bare. A water lily blossom is tucked behind one ear. Her face is lean and angular, not a classical beauty, with a cold, luring expression. Full-length figure: the whole body from head to feet inside the frame, isolated on blank paper.

visual.text: A monochrome silverpoint character study: a single figure alone on plain off-white paper, drawn only in fine grey metalpoint lines and hatching, like a page from a Renaissance master's sketchbook. A swamp creature that is a crossbreed of a huge frog and a man. His body is human in shape and stands upright, but his head is shaped like a frog's, with a very wide frog mouth stretching across it and big, bulging, alien frog eyes set far apart. His skin is frog skin all over: slimy, warty and mottled. A gross, scraggly, mossy beard hangs from his chin, and stringy, scraggly hair hangs from the top of his head. His fingers are long frog fingers, webbed, with round tips and claws. He has a fat, sagging belly. Full-length figure: the whole body from head to feet inside the frame, isolated on blank paper.
